act_title: Go to the Institute of Clockwork Applications and retrieve the Anchor

quests.title: Go to the Institute of Clockwork Applications and retrieve the Anchor

dialogue.t: I believe this place was originally Butor's "Institute of Clockwork Applications." In the field of clockwork machines, Monsieur Butor was one of the leading authorities.

However, scientifically, the development and advancement of traditional clockwork machines had reached a bottleneck. In terms of applications, traditional clockwork machines were obviously at a great disadvantage.
Anyway, Monsieur Butor's program was slowly being marginalized at the Institute. His funding was cut, and he struggled to recruit researchers.
After a series of unfortunate incidents, Monsieur Butor's group finally disbanded, and this facility was completely abandoned.
*sigh* Monsieur Butor was terribly unlucky, if you ask me...
Yeah... I still can't forget how Choiseul just kept equivocating.
And that Raimondo... So haughty and arrogant. Did you see how he was looking at me?
I think you're much better than either of those two. Things would have never turned out like that if you were in their position.
There should be a Survey Anchor here too. I'll open the door, and leave the recovery to you, {NICKNAME}.

quests.description: You arrived at the new Fontaine Research Institute and met with co-administrators Raimondo and Choiseul. After a long, mind-numbing conversation, you were tasked to escort Nacker and retrieve the last two Anchors.
